statusLine.command: cwd=$(cat | sed -n 's/.*"cwd"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p'); proj=$(basename "$cwd"); mode=$(cat "$cwd/.claude/state/MODE" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$mode" ]; then m=$(echo "$mode" | cut -d: -f1 | tr -d ' '); d=$(grep -cE '- \[x\]|- \[~\]' "$cwd/.claude/state/TASKS.md" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); t=$(grep -c '- \[' "$cwd/.claude/state/TASKS.md" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); [ "$t" -gt 0 ] && echo "ACE $proj $m $d/$t" || echo "ACE $proj $m"; else echo "ACE $proj"; fi
